entities.name: Alpha-bromoketone substrate
observations: Contains a bromomethyl ketone electrophile suitable for SN2 substitution.

entities.name: 4-Chlorophenol
observations: Phenolic oxygen is deprotonated by potassium carbonate and acts as the nucleophile.

entities.name: Phenoxy ketone formation
observations: Proposed reaction: phenoxide displacement of bromide from the bromomethyl ketone under K2CO3 in acetone.
The product is an alpha-(4-chlorophenoxy)methyl ketone; no new stereocenter is formed at the substituted methylene.
